findings.source_arabic:
وإذا كتبت في لوح من
رصاص ووضعت في شبكة الصياد كثر صيده
findings.reason: Unqualified رصاص denotes lead, not tin. Indonesian timah alone denotes tin; specify timah hitam. English already says lead in the observed snapshot.

findings.source_arabic: الرحيم في قطعة رصاص ويضع اسم من يريد في الوفق
findings.reason: قطعة رصاص is a piece of lead. Keep it distinct from قصدير (tin), explicitly contrasted with رصاص on p039. English already accurate.

findings.source_arabic: الوقود وإياك أن تلحق النار الرصاص فإن المعمول يهلك
findings.reason: The warning repeats the same lead object (الرصاص); both Indonesian mentions need timah hitam, not tin. English already accurate.

ambiguity_policy.lead_tin: No credible lead/tin ambiguity in these matches; do not change accurate قصدير = tin/timah on p015/p039.
ambiguity_policy.other: p045 نحاس أصفر literally yellow copper, commonly brass; existing yellow-copper/tembaga kuning preserves the source and is not a reportable mistranslation. p026 تفصيل الحديد ولبسه and p027 surrounding syntax are unusual, but حديد remains iron/besi; no speculative harmonization.
ambiguity_policy.excluded_homonyms: p036 حَدِيدُ الْبَصَرِ = sharp-eyed, not iron; p067 قلعة ماردين = citadel of Mardin, not tin.

verification: All six EN/ID old anchors occur exactly once in their respective observed target files. No source, target, code, or tracker mutated; this report is the only created artifact.
